title: Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources
what_it_is: Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources

sections.label: Carbon tax from 2019
sections.summary: The carbon tax takes effect from 2019 and provides an economy-wide price signal to spur emissions reduction.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The carbon tax, which takes effect from 2019, will provide an economy-wide price signal to spur emissions reduction.

sections.label: Government recycling and waste frameworks
sections.summary: The Government will develop infrastructure and frameworks, including Extended Producer Responsibility, mandatory packaging reporting by 2021, and support for onsite food waste digesters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Government will take the lead by developing infrastructure and frameworks, such as the Extended Producer Responsibility framework to enhance recycling and manage electrical and electronic waste.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We are implementing mandatory reporting of packaging data and packaging waste reduction plans by 2021 and supporting the wider use of onsite food waste digesters at commercial premises and hawker centres.

sections.label: Integrating facilities cuts emissions
sections.summary: Integrating the facilities will reduce carbon emissions by more than 200,000 tonnes annually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Integrating the facilities will reduce carbon emissions by more than 200,000 tonnes annually.

sections.label: Smart Water Grid sensor stations
sections.summary: Under the Smart Water Grid, 320 sensor stations island-wide monitor 5,500 kilometres of water distribution pipe network in real-time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: As part of our Smart Water Grid, we have set up 320 sensor stations island-wide to monitor 5,500 kilometres of water distribution pipe network real-time.

sections.label: ABC Waters projects completion
sections.summary: ABC Waters projects at locations such as Jurong Lake and Sungei Whampoa will be completed over the next few years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Over the next few years, ABC Waters projects at locations, such as the Jurong Lake and Sungei Whampoa, will be completed.

sections.label: New hawker centres and initiatives
sections.summary: Twenty new hawker centres were announced in 2015, seven have opened, and Hawker Centre 3.0 initiatives and productivity measures are being extended.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In 2015, we announced that we would build 20 new hawker centres by 2027.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Since then, seven new modern hawker centres have opened.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Our Hawker Centre 3.0 initiatives are aimed at ensuring the viability, vitality and continuity of the hawker trade.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We are extending productivity initiatives, such as the automated tray return systems and centralised dishwashing services, to more hawker centres.
